title: Style Module Imports via `<link>` Elements

labels.name: topic: shadow
labels.description: Relates to shadow trees (as defined in DOM)

body:
### What problem are you trying to solve?

Developers using Declarative Shadow DOM (DSD) do not have a way to share declarative stylesheets without using script. There are many workarounds, but none are ideal.

### What solutions exist today?

If a developer wants to share styles between the light DOM and DSD, they can either:

a. Duplicate individual inline style rules between shadow roots. This is problematic because it often leads to lots of duplicated style definitions, which put pressure on the parser and are un-ergonomic and bloat memory if CSSOM is used to modify their styles.
b. Use `<link rel>` tags for shared CSS files in each shadow root. This is problematic because external stylesheets are an asynchronous render-blocking resource, and could cause an FOUC. They are also un-ergonomic and bloat memory if CSSOM is used to modify their styles.
c. Use the Javascript `adoptedStyleSheets` property on the declarative shadow root to share stylesheets. This is problematic because the shadow root created by Declarative Shadow DOM does not exist until the `<template>` tag is parsed, resulting in a guaranteed FOUC.

None of these options are ideal. 

### How would you solve it?

Augmenting `<link rel=stylesheet>` with an `import` attribute to perform the stylesheet fetch through the module map.

Proposed syntax:

```
<link rel="stylesheet" import="foo">
```

The `import"` attribute on the `<link>` element with `rel=stylesheet` signifies that this is a style module fetch and style application. It will perform [resolve a module specifier](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-resolution-algorithm:resolve-a-module-specifier) on the value of `import` and use the resulting URL to [fetch a single module script](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-a-single-module-script) with a `moduleType` of "style". Upon fetch completion, the stylesheet will be added applied in a similar manner as [LinkStyle](https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#the-linkstyle-interface).

Explainer: https://github.com/MicrosoftEdge/MSEdgeExplainers/blob/main/ShadowDOM/explainer.md
